name: Andrea Hoyos
quote: Those strawberries are delicious! If you're looking for something that's a bit like a Colombian ice cream shop and pastry shop, this is the perfect place! You'll be craving more!

name: Eylin Duarte
quote: I love desserts and this place has the best. I recommend the brownie cup. The service is excellent, very friendly, and the atmosphere is great. I'll definitely be back!

name: Angelica Escobar
quote: The best strawberries and cream I've ever had! The amount of toppings makes every bite feel like an explosion of flavors in your mouth. I'll be coming back every week!

name: Imad A.
quote: Amazing strawberry cups, good people! Highly recommend.

name: Bensolly Gomez V.
quote: It is my favorite place and my kids too are happy with all flavors the Strawberry Shop.

name: Taylor Chiller
quote: Bowls are loaded with strawberries, cream, and toppings layered perfectly so that you get a little bit of everything in each bite. 10/10 highly recommend!!!

name: Tracey Stenson
quote: Love the Strawberry and different toppings.

name: Lissette Deleon
quote: We were visiting from out of town and ended up at Liberty Center when we saw the Strawberry Shop. The line was pretty long, but we figured it had to be good if that many people were waiting. Glad we gave it a shot because everything was super fresh and really good. It was honestly one of the best parts of the trip. Definitely worth stopping by.

name: Anonymous
quote: This place is DANGEROUS… in the best way. The strawberries are insanely fresh, the cream is smooth and perfect, and the chocolate? Unreal. I came 'just to try it' and now I'm already planning my next visit. If you haven't been here yet… you're missing out. RUN, don't walk.
